mechanism: Two independent aggregation seams change the denominator for a fixed dataset. Exact footprint represents request count; amber height represents the current aggregate error rate. Same 40 v2-export failures, constant amber volume of 0.15 cubic scene units across all selections. Splitting both seams exposes 40%, versus 4% for either seam alone and 0.4% pooled.
spatialBenefit: Area-times-height makes denominator dilution visible; independent seams allow either slicing order and the intersection.
beyondVideoTest: Try version only, operation only and both: only the intersection exposes 40%. Underlying counts and amber volume remain fixed throughout.
